title: 我差点用错了 OpenWorkflow 的入口
scope_summary: A focused dogfood devlog from 2026-05-22 about discovering that OpenWorkflow's current repo capability surface must be read through the repo-built dist CLI, not the globally installed openworkflow binary.
narrative_thesis: In a self-hosted workflow repo, CLI capability discovery is not a convenience step; it is part of the Agent trust boundary.

decision_arcs.title: 入口不是实现细节
decision_arcs.situation: The Agent followed AGENTS.md and first ran the globally installed openworkflow binary.
decision_arcs.tension: The global binary exposed only the older maintenance command surface, while the dogfood repo had newer Agent-facing commands in dist.
decision_arcs.decision: Treat the repo-built dist CLI as the current dogfood capability source for this repository.

evidence.summary: Global openworkflow help lists only init, validate, sync, doctor, and clean.
Repo dist CLI help lists handoff, status, inspect, context, draft, register, summaries, summarize, git-automation, and clean.
The package bin maps openworkflow to dist/cli/src/index.js.

decision_arcs.outcome: The Agent used the correct command surface for handoff and context loading.
decision_arcs.reusable_lesson: In the OpenWorkflow dogfood repo, confirm capability source before trusting capability lists; use node dist/cli/src/index.js for current repo behavior.
decision_arcs.teaching_moment: Show the global-vs-dist help output side by side.

decision_arcs.title: AGENTS 指令需要运行时绑定
decision_arcs.situation: AGENTS.md tells Agents to run openworkflow commands and also says dogfood work should use OpenWorkflow commands as read model and trust gate.
decision_arcs.tension: The command name alone did not identify whether the Agent was invoking the installed package or the current repo build.
decision_arcs.decision: Interpret the semantic command through the repo dist CLI when working inside OpenWorkflow itself.

evidence.summary: AGENTS.md says to run openworkflow --help first.
AGENTS.md says dogfooding should use OpenWorkflow commands as the read model and trust gate.
The repo source help text includes the expanded command surface and Agent quick start.

decision_arcs.outcome: The content distinguishes semantic command names from versioned execution entrypoints.
decision_arcs.reusable_lesson: Agent instructions should bind command semantics to the correct runtime entrypoint when a tool is dogfooding itself.
decision_arcs.teaching_moment: Explain why a generated instruction can be semantically right while operationally under-specified in a dogfood repo.

decision_arcs.title: handoff 是信任门
decision_arcs.situation: After switching to the dist CLI, the Agent ran handoff and context with JSON output.
decision_arcs.tension: Without the trust gate, the Agent would either over-read raw workflow files or rely on stale assumptions.
decision_arcs.decision: Use dist CLI handoff/context as the bounded startup packet before deeper exploration.

evidence.summary: Status reports a clean branch, active_stage workflow, next_command /ow:vision, and healthy managed surface.
Help describes JSON report envelopes and how to read health_errors, errors, and warnings.

decision_arcs.outcome: The Agent had a clear continuation state without touching managed stage artifacts.
decision_arcs.reusable_lesson: Use the OpenWorkflow handoff/context pair to control trust and read scope before raw evidence exploration.
decision_arcs.teaching_moment: Turn handoff output into a small trust-gate checklist.

privacy_actions: No secrets, credentials, emails, customer identifiers, or private business data were included.
Local absolute user paths were avoided in published narrative content except repository-relative evidence pointers.
html_deck_outline: Diff lens: global CLI vs dist CLI
